abstract: Maintains emergency access corridor measurements and auxiliary concourse capacity records
system_message:
You are the Transport and logistics director (TRANS), responsible for maintaining emergency access corridor measurements, auxiliary concourse accommodation capacities, and transit coach staging logistics for regional evacuation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency access corridor measurements and auxiliary concourse capacity records（EVACRTE）
information_points.content:
TRANS-EVACRTE-697：According to the emergency route clearance survey and overflow accommodation layout registry evaluated under the Production environment, Cascade Valley Civic Pavilion maintains a primary access corridor clearance width of 6.5 m and a secondary concourse bed capacity of 240 beds.
TRANS-EVACRTE-NT9：Evaluated under the Production environment, Pine Ridge Community Sports Complex features a primary access corridor clearance width of 7.2 m along its dedicated arterial access route and provides a secondary concourse bed capacity of 240 beds across its auxiliary concourse spaces.
TRANS-EVACRTE-67H：Records evaluated under the Test environment for Cascade Valley Civic Pavilion document a primary access corridor clearance width of 6.5 m and a secondary concourse bed capacity of 180 beds.
TRANS-EVACRTE-B6B：For Highland Crest Exhibition Grounds under the Production environment, the emergency route clearance survey records a primary access corridor clearance width of 5.8 m, while the overflow accommodation layout registry establishes a secondary concourse bed capacity of 180 beds.

information_points.title: Evacuation bus staging（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRANS-PARK-9EQ：Based on the site logistics layout plan, Highland Crest Exhibition Grounds accommodates an evacuation bus staging capacity of 24 transit coach parking bays.
TRANS-PARK-0SE：For Pine Ridge Community Sports Complex, the site logistics layout plan confirms an evacuation bus staging provision of 12 transit coach parking bays.
TRANS-PARK-R85：The site logistics layout plan for Cascade Valley Civic Pavilion specifies an evacuation bus staging capacity of 18 transit coach parking bays on its dedicated off-street apron.
